desc: Defender pump shotgun with full coverage Forged Carbon finish. Uses interchangeable Invector-Plus chokes. Chrome-plated bore and chamber. The SXP Defender is designed to be a compact pump-action shotgun with a tough and good looking finish that you can toss in with your gear each time you go offroad, camping, fishing, or just off the grid to get away from it all. Built to use interchangeable Invector-Plus chokes, you can get excellent patterns for taking small game or screw in the appropriate choke for the buckshot or slugs for protection against bears.
